app.name: WordWise
app.description: Learn vocabulary and remember it with smart review scheduling.

today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Add a word you just came across, or pick a ready-made set for your goal.

words.title: My words
words.emptyBody: Words you add will live in your notebooks here.

practice.title: Practice
practice.emptyBody: Add a few words to practise by notebook, topic or mode.

stats.title: Stats
stats.emptyBody: Finish your first review session to see your progress.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Changes right away, no reload needed.
settings.guestBody: Your data is only on this device. Create an account to keep it safe and learn on multiple devices.
settings.dailyNewHint: Saved on this device right away, syncs when online.
settings.signOutPending: {count} changes haven't been uploaded yet. Signing out now will lose them.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.tagline: Learn English vocabulary and remember it with smart review scheduling.
welcome.tryNowHint: No account needed, data stays on this device.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email and we'll send a sign-in link and code. New here? We'll create your account.
login.privacyHint: We only use your email to sign you in and sync your learning data.
login.sentTo: We sent an email to {email}. Tap the link in it, or enter the code from it here.

errors.link_expired: This link has expired or was already used. Please request a new sign-in email.
errors.oauth: Google sign-in didn't finish. Try again or use email.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.sendFailed: Couldn't send the email. Check the address and your connection.
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't available on this build yet. You can still try the app without an account.

auth.finishFailed: Sign-in didn't finish. Your data on this device is safe, please try again.
auth.needsJavascript: JavaScript is required to sign in.

onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

language.title: Which language do you want to learn?
language.body: You can add more languages later.
language.more: Japanese, Chinese, Korean and French are coming later.

level.title: Your current level
level.body: Used to suggest words that fit you. Not sure? Pick the closest, you can change it in Settings.

daily.title: How many new words per day?
daily.body: Start small to keep a steady pace. You can change it anytime.
daily.estimate: About {minutes} minutes of new words a day, not counting reviews.

reminder.title: Study reminder
reminder.toggle: Remind me to study every day

notify.title: Turn on study reminders?
notify.body: We'll remind you at {time} every day, nothing else.

starter.title: 5 words to start
starter.body: Picked for your level. Learn them now to start day one of your streak.
starter.emptyBody: Add the first word you want to remember.

sync.local: Data is saved on this device

wordCard.title: Word card
wordCard.notInNotebook: This word is not in your notebooks yet.

sheet.missingWord: The sentence should contain “{word}” (or one of its forms) for fill-in exercises. You can still save it.
sheet.examplesHint: Your sentences are preferred in fill-in exercises.
sheet.tooMany: You can add at most {max} items per meaning in this tab.
sheet.invalid: Please enter some text (within the length limit).
sheet.customMeaningHint: The original is kept; you can switch back any time.

image.title: Your memory image
image.hint: The photo is resized and only you can see it.
image.failed: Couldn't upload. Check your connection and try again.
image.needAccount: Sign in to use your own images.
image.needOnline: You need a connection to upload.
image.unsupported: Couldn't read this image. Choose a JPG or PNG.

reportSheet.title: Report a problem
reportSheet.body: Your report goes to the content team. The shared card isn't changed right away.
reportSheet.limit: You've sent the maximum number of reports today.
reportSheet.failed: Couldn't send. Please try again later.
reportSheet.needOnline: You need a connection to send a report.

state.retrying: Content isn't ready yet, we'll keep trying.
state.offline: This word isn't on your device yet. Connect to load it.
state.loginRequired: “{word}” isn't in the library yet. Sign in to create a card for new words.
state.limitReached: You've used all new words for today. Try again tomorrow.
